description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It extends a base activity, manages a fragment displaying active notifications, and includes menu options to toggle a log view displayed within a ViewAnimator. It also initializes a logging chain that outputs logs both to the console and on-screen within a LogFragment.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity class that manages the app's main screen, including fragment transactions, menu interactions, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and adds the ActiveNotificationsFragment if no previous state exists.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu items based on UI state, such as showing or hiding the log toggle and setting its title.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu items, particularly toggling the log view display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Configures a logging chain comprising LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment to output logs both to console and UI.
